Module dev.metaschema.core

Package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.flexmark

package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.flexmark
Support for parsing and rendering HTML and Markdown text using Flexmark.

This package provides Flexmark-based infrastructure for Metaschema markup processing, including custom extensions, visitors, and writers for specialized Metaschema markup requirements. The implementation uses the Flexmark library for Markdown parsing and HTML rendering.

Core Components

  • FlexmarkFactory - Factory for creating configured Flexmark parser and renderer instances with Metaschema-specific extensions
  • FlexmarkConfiguration - Centralized configuration for Flexmark options and extensions

Custom Extensions

Metaschema-specific Flexmark extensions:

  • HtmlQuoteTagExtension - Supports HTML <q> tag parsing and rendering
  • InsertAnchorExtension - Enables insertion of anchor elements for headings
  • HtmlCodeRenderExtension - Custom rendering for inline code elements
  • SuppressPTagExtension - Suppresses paragraph tags in single-line markup
  • FixedEmphasisDelimiterProcessor - Fixes emphasis delimiter processing for Metaschema requirements

Visitors and Writers

  • IMarkupVisitor - Interface for visiting markup AST nodes
  • MarkupVisitor - Default visitor implementation for processing markup nodes
  • IMarkupWriter - Interface for writing markup to various output formats
  • MarkupXmlEventWriter - Writes markup as XML events (StAX event-based API)
  • MarkupXmlStreamWriter - Writes markup as XML stream (StAX stream-based API)

Usage Context

This package is primarily used internally by the dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup package to handle the low-level parsing and rendering of markup content. The Flexmark extensions ensure that Metaschema markup conforms to specification requirements while supporting a rich subset of Markdown and HTML features.
